convert_single_line_comments: run the script to convert single line // comments to /** */ block format in a source file
convert_multi_line_comment_blocks: run the script to convert consecutive // comment lines into a single /** */ block comment
preserve_comment_indentation: run the script to transform comments while preserving their original indentation levels
process_multiple_files: run the script with multiple file arguments to batch convert comment styles across source files
extract_comment_content: run the script to parse // comment lines and extract their content using regex pattern matching
